description: snippy + snippy-core: reference FASTA plus per-sample paired-read directories
invocation_hint: for dir in samples/*/; do name=$(basename $dir); snippy --ref reference.fasta --R1 $dir/reads_1.fq.gz --R2 $dir/reads_2.fq.gz --outdir ${name}_snps; done && snippy-core --ref reference.fasta *_snps/
